# The weekend cover note

Lena is away and Mum has arranged transport with another neighbour herself. I am not the dispatcher. We agreed which messages need an immediate response and which can wait until evening. [[Care arrangements]] is becoming shorter as the arrangements become clearer. Do not mistake fewer lines in my notebook for less care being provided.
